label: post_outcome_diagnostic_not_alpha_validation

primaryResult.interpretation: The Primary direction worked without needing the future-best peer. Both frozen acceptable expressions beat CSI300 at 60d, validating the opportunity-first contract.

researchDiagnostics.interpretation: The diversified preferred expression still beat the benchmark even though the purer Tesla control did better at 60d; by 120d the preferred expression later outperformed the control. This argues against a fixed purity or diversification preference.

The product/company engine remained powerful despite ~49x 2020E PE and extreme pre-cutoff theme rerating. High absorption alone cannot be a veto when fresh product-level demand and realized earnings acceleration remain strong.

Late-cycle risk was real, but the realized company engine and equity reset still supported substantial 60d excess. Exact peer-best ranking is secondary because the selected expression itself was highly adequate.

serverDRAM.reason: No direct A-share server-DRAM earnings expression was frozen before reveal.

preCutoffEvidenceAvailable: 2019-12-03 MIIT draft development plan targeted roughly 25% NEV share of new vehicle sales by 2025 and reinforced battery/electric-drive policy direction.
CATL 2019Q3 filing showed 1-9M revenue +71.7%, attributable profit +45.65%,扣非 +49.34%, operating cash flow +81.99% despite weak aggregate NEV sales.

The frozen price regime already showed strong CATL divergence while BYD had not participated over 60d; this should have triggered company/structural-policy decomposition rather than a broad-sector veto.
broadNEV.processLesson: Evidence at different horizons must not automatically cancel. Short-term sector demand contraction can coexist with a multi-year policy reset and a leader-specific share/earnings engine. The system should split these into separate hypotheses and demand separate falsifiers.

hypothesisGranularity: 2020Q1 memory miss: server-DRAM framing caused adjacent NOR/NAND opportunity to be discarded.
2019Q4 decomposition: separating NOR Flash from server DRAM produced a strong Research direction while server DRAM correctly remained No selection.
expectationAbsorption: 2020Q1 5G/server/gold show that visible bullish narratives and prior rerating can indeed fail.
2019Q4 NOR and 2020Q2 construction/PV show that high prior rerating or tight expectations are not sufficient alone to veto a still-accelerating company/product engine.
expressionAdequacy: 2019Q4 Tesla: the preferred diversified expression was adequate though not 60d peer-best.
2020Q1/2020Q2 gold: repeated pure-exposure preference toward Shandong Gold was inadequate versus benchmark/control.
Therefore directness is one input, not a ranking objective; expectation burden, earnings conversion and downside containment must jointly determine adequacy.

versionDecision.reason: The same structural failure classes now recur or receive independent-window support: hypothesis granularity, multi-horizon evidence conflict, leader-vs-sector divergence, and overly mechanical absorption vetoes. V1.4 should formalize these diagnostics without retroactively changing historical selections.
v14ChangesToImplement: Mandatory hypothesis-decomposition audit when evidence points to distinct products, geographies, customer groups or time horizons with materially different causal paths.
Explicit evidence-horizon matrix separating near-term physical demand, medium-term earnings conversion and longer-term structural/policy drivers; one horizon may not silently veto another.
Leader-divergence diagnostic when sector aggregates weaken but company share/revenue/profit/cash flow are accelerating.
High-absorption continuation diagnostic distinguishing fresh incremental earnings/product evidence from mere confirmation of a known narrative.

Expression-purity check: never prefer the purest thematic exposure solely because its causal mapping is cleaner; retain valuation, expectation path, earnings quality and downside containment as co-equal constraints.
versionDecision.promotionPolicy: Do not automatically loosen High-priority gates from 2019Q4. Introduce the new diagnostics first and validate the resulting V1.4 candidate unchanged on another untouched historical window before treating the continuation route as a promotion override.

prohibitedUses: Do not change frozen 2019Q4 selections after reveal.
Do not infer that all high-valuation/high-momentum growth should be promoted.
Do not infer that weak current sector sales are irrelevant; instead separate current-demand, policy-duration and leader-specific hypotheses.
Do not claim historical replay is clean alpha validation.
